gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Tue Jun 16 22:51:43 GMT 2026
ADDED i2: A negative threshold is rejected by the constructor.
ADDED i4: The unlimited (default) instance comparing a 26-char buffer against an empty wrapped view of it reports a distance of 26, all from deletions.
ADDED i5: Wrapping at position 26..26 yields an empty view of the same buffer.
ADDED i6: Two empty strings have zero distance and zero of every operation.
ADDED i7: The unlimited instance rejects a null right input.
ADDED i10: The default instance rejects two null inputs.
ADDED i13: When the true distance exceeds the threshold, apply returns -1. Here a 13-char buffer versus a 14-char string needs more edits than 13 allows.
ADDED i14: With threshold 0, comparing a buffer with itself gives distance 0.
ADDED i15: A threshold of 1 is too small for a 1-char buffer versus a 10-char string, so the limited algorithm returns -1.
ADDED i16: With Integer.MAX_VALUE threshold, a buffer compared to itself is distance 0.
ADDED i17: An 858-char buffer versus a 10-char string within an 858 threshold reports a distance of 858, of which 848 are deletions (the surplus length).
ADDED i18: A 1470-char buffer versus an empty view of itself, with threshold 1470, needs 1470 deletions and nothing else.
ADDED i19: With threshold 0, an 11-char buffer versus an empty buffer exceeds the threshold, so the distance is -1 and all operation counts are zero.
ADDED i20: With threshold 0, two empty buffers have zero distance and no operations.
ADDED i21: With threshold 0, an empty buffer versus a 1839-char buffer exceeds the threshold, so the distance is -1 and all operation counts are zero.
ADDED i22: A thresholded instance also rejects a null right input.
ADDED i25: A thresholded instance rejects two null inputs.
ADDED i28: Two buffers that share an 'S' at a single differing position but differ in length yield a distance of 2 under the unlimited algorithm.
ADDED i29: Comparing a 7-char buffer to an 8-char buffer (left to right) records three substitutions and no deletions.
ADDED i30: Comparing an 8-char buffer to a 7-char buffer (left to right) records a distance of 3 with no substitutions (the differences resolve as inserts).
ADDED i31: With a threshold of 7, comparing a 7-char buffer to an 8-char buffer that shares some 'f' characters yields a distance of 3.
ADDED i32: A mock whose length() returns -1 on the first calls is treated as empty by both branches, so comparing it to itself yields distance 0.
ADDED i33: A mock whose length() returns -1 then 0 is treated as empty, so comparing it to itself yields distance 0.
ADDED i34: The default instance has no threshold configured.
